_meta.name: build-data
_meta.purpose: Compact data the Builds tab (Engine B) reads. DERIVED, not a source of truth.
_meta.syncRule: When any source file changes in the project, regenerate this file and republish it beside the page. Never hand-edit knowledge here that isn't also in a source file.
engineAssumptions: Scoring weights and the mystling ranking are Claude's design, not documented game facts. Tunable.
'Close/Far Behaviour' from the compiled builds is shown as Range priority Melee/Long in the preset. Mapping inferred.
'Spinning Orb' in the Griffin + Circle build isn't a rune name in runes.json. Treated as the 'Circle' ability rune, flagged.
'Required' characters (runes.json builds) mean deployed or in a resonance slot. Confirmed by Daby for Griffin + Circle (Thor); applied by inference to Dragoon + Element + Meteor (Cleo, Otta).
corrections: 2026-11-21 (Daby): the Arena preset is NOT the build used in Guild Expedition. Removed the tool's note saying it was. Source docs (gear.json presetSystem.expeditionUses, game-modes.json Battle phase, characters.json resonance.note) still say otherwise and need correcting.

gearQualityNote: Per Daby 2026-11-21: Epic 3 levels, Legendary 3, Mythic 4, Godforge 10. Read as base + plus-levels (to confirm).
runeQualityNote: Per Daby 2026-11-21. Twinborn = two Mythic runes combined into one slot with both benefits; rare at ArchAcademy's power level. Scored like Mythic for now; details later. (runes.json still says 'Normal' for the lowest tier and Legendary+2 for the Twinborn requirement.)
deployRule: Per Daby 2026-11-21: deployed and resonance abilities count equally and order doesn't matter. Deploy any character at ★6+ so both resonance slots unlock; if none is ★6+, deploy the highest-star character and accept a locked slot.

characters.Thor: Thor (★2+): moving gives a chance to summon a homing Mjolnir. Keep moving.
characters.Loki: Loki: moving gives a chance to enter Focus State (+20% ATK). Keep moving.
characters.Nyanja: Nyanja: Swift Wind fires periodically on its own; movement speed helps you stay on the target.
characters.Nezha: Nezha: your movement path burns. Walk back and forth through the target.
characters.Otta: Otta (★8): farther range means higher CRIT Rate, up to +15%. Keep your distance.

gear.Griffin: Griffin gear rewards staying close: within about 7m you get more damage, CRIT and attack speed. Stay right next to the target.

behavior.close: This build is set up for close range.
behavior.far: This build is set up for long range.

Dragoon.identity: AoE/explosion with built-in sustain, the 'tanky nuker' set. Best PvP set, decent PvE.

Griffin.identity: Close-range brawler, PvP-leaning. Weak in PvP and PvE until Chaotic.

Oracle.identity: Combo/crit scaling, ranged DPS. Best PvE set.

Dragoon.weapon: +5% main weapon DMG per skill taken, up to +50%
Dragoon.amulet: explosion-damaged enemies may attract a meteor
Dragoon.helmet: ignited enemies take double explosion DMG

Griffin.amulet: taking DMG within 7m: chance to drop Hearts
Griffin.ring: Hearts heal up to 100% more at low HP
Griffin.helmet: ATK SPD up to +100% the closer you are

Oracle.weapon: more enemies hit = higher next attack DMG
Oracle.ring: combo >40: bonus DMG to max-HP enemies
Oracle.armor: looting Hearts: chance at 2s Invincibility Shield

mystlingNote: Mystling ranking is Claude's heuristic from the documented skills, not a sourced tier list. In Expedition/Arena/Peak Arena, active skills start the match at 50% cooldown.

synergies.label: Invincible core (Griffin Amulet + Griffin Ring + Oracle Armor)
synergies.why: The three-piece core every top-tier PvP gear combo shares. Griffin Amulet drops Hearts when you're hit; Oracle Armor gives a 2s invincibility chance when you loot Hearts.

synergies.label: Griffin Amulet + Oracle Armor proc chain
synergies.why: Getting hit drops Hearts (Griffin Amulet), looting Hearts can grant 2s invincibility (Oracle Armor).

synergies.label: Dragoon gear + Meteor runes
synergies.why: Dragoon's kit is explosion/Meteor-based and Meteor damage is always elemental, so the gear and the Meteor runes feed the same damage pool.

synergies.label: Cleo + Flamenox runes
synergies.why: Cleo already makes your attacks Fire. Flamenox adds Poison, and at Mythic triggers an explosion every second when Fire and Poison are both on a target.

synergies.label: Thor/Rolla + Frostshock runes
synergies.why: Thor supplies Lightning (Rolla supplies Ice), so Frostshock's Frozen/Paralyzed bonuses get half their combo for free.

synergies.label: Elemental Crit + elemental character
synergies.why: Elemental damage normally ignores your CRIT stats. Elemental Crit lets it inherit 10-30% of them, so crit investment pays off on burn/shock/freeze too.

synergies.label: Witch + elemental character
synergies.why: Witch applies Elemental Vulnerability; your elemental damage cashes it in.

synergies.label: Nezha + Flamenox runes
synergies.why: Nezha's burning trail may make him a second Fire-native character. Third-party source, unconfirmed.

synergies.label: Demon King Atreus + damage reduction
synergies.why: Shield-based sustain should layer with damage reduction. No specific pairing confirmed yet.

synergies.label: Dragoon Armor + Mymu
synergies.why: Flame Shield regen might pair with Overdraw in PvE. Likely dead weight in PvP, where constant hits pop the shield.

skillTips.tip: In-run skill tip: Thor takes no penalty from Weapon Enchantment (everyone else loses 30% ATK and ATK SPD). Doesn't apply in Expedition, where in-run skills reset.
In-run skill tip: skip Swift Arrow with an Oracle Helmet (Chaotic). The helmet's Multishot delay cancels most of Swift Arrow's attack speed (hand-tested, ~12% gain instead of ~80%).
